scope.goal: N7.5 Webhooks - Aplicacion, servicios y API
scope.acceptance: Implementar repositorios/servicios/casos de uso/DTOs/API/errores/paginacion/filtros/idempotencia estrictamente del punto; soportar firma, validacion, replay protection, idempotencia y logging.
scope.validations: Build backend y pruebas dirigidas; contratos HTTP/ProblemDetails correctos cuando aplique.

source_findings.detail: Current Desarrollo tree contains the inbound webhook domain entity plus persistence configuration/migration, but no WebhookEntrante repository under Infrastructure/Repositories, no webhook-specific service under Infrastructure/Services, and no Webhook-named component in current Application/API trees. N7.5.D therefore lacks the application/API path required by its row scope and cannot be LISTO_REAL yet.
source_findings.required_recovery: Implement the minimal coherent repository/application service/DTO/API path for inbound webhooks, including provider/event validation, payload-based idempotency/replay conflict handling, tenant-safe persistence/logging, HTTP/ProblemDetails semantics where applicable, DI wiring, and targeted tests.

next_action: Resolve INBOUND_WEBHOOK_APPLICATION_API_MISSING same-run if safely implementable, then run proportional backend build/tests and repeat REVIEW_FIRST until P0=0/P1=0.
